paraphrase: Eight existence claims. (1) An expressive uncollapsed predicate with a two-member all-holding domain and a two-member all-failing domain. (2) On the pilot language: global profile variation with every profile collapsed; global variation with some profile uncollapsed; the pilot's stable-logical local variation. (3) STMT-NO-GLOBAL-PROPOSITIONAL-COLLAPSE alongside an inhabited type with no two distinct elements, a fixing step function and an empty relation, all uninterpreted. (4) A predicate and negation where some content and its negation hold, another content fails, negation is exhaustive and not exclusive, and the predicate does not collapse. (5) An all-hold model with exhaustive non-exclusive negation and an all-fail model with exclusive non-exhaustive negation. (6) No absolute truth, a disquoting non-capturing thesis, every agent's predicate expressive and uncollapsed, the thesis true for one agent and not the other. (7) Total nihilism on inhabited contents with exclusive negation. (8) A disquoting and capturing thesis that is not absolutely true, with another content absolutely true. Consistency of these encodings only: no defense of what they model and no source reading.
